segments.text: My name is Ryan Heath and I am an attorney licensed in the state of Arizona.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I specialize in constitutional law as well as election law.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I will be speaking at the VSRF conference about
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My work as a civil rights activist at the beginning of 2022, I flew around the state of California and I taught kids and their parents how to disobey their schools COVID-19 mask mandates for the purpose of setting up Rosa Parks style lawsuits to hold the individuals that were abusing children in the name of the greater good accountable.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If you want to actually come out and see one of our clients, Nicole, who has filed a lawsuit against Coronado Unified School District in San Diego County, speak about her case as well as with her attorney, Tracy Henderson.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You should come out and see what it is that we have going on.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Other attorneys should consider attending this conference because they're going to hear about legal theories that they've never imagined before, specifically with respect to the First Amendment and the exercise of free speech within the classroom context as it relates to COVID-19 mandates.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Based on the First Amendment, case law is very clear about this.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So if you want to come learn about that, I'll be speaking about that in particular.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And if you're a member of the public, you should come out to learn more about your constitutional rights because the next time this does come around, and it will, you should know how to defend yourself and how to stand up.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
